candidate_windows.window_text: The conceptor-intervened model is trained for one epoch by setting prediction_loss_only as true and per_device_train_batch_size as 8. Following the training procedure in Devlin et al. (2019), we train by tasks Masked Language Model (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) simultaneously. The training corpus is the Wikipedia dump from datasets library (Lhoest et al., 2021).
